storage_policy_declarations.name: Users can upload permitted payment proofs
storage_policy_declarations.declaration:
create policy "Users can upload permitted payment proofs"
on storage.objects for insert
to authenticated
with check (
  bucket_id = 'payment-proofs'
  and (
    (
      (storage.foldername(name))[1] = 'personal'
      and (storage.foldername(name))[2] = (select auth.uid())::text
    )
    or (
      (storage.foldername(name))[1] = 'families'
      and (storage.foldername(name))[4] = (select auth.uid())::text
      and exists (
        select 1
        from public.families
        where families.id = ((storage.foldername(name))[2])::uuid
          and families.owner_id::text = (storage.foldername(name))[3]
          and public.is_active_family_participant(families.id)
      )
    )
  )
);

storage_policy_declarations.name: Users can read permitted payment proofs
Owners can delete payment proofs
Owners can upload subscription proofs
storage_policy_declarations.declaration:
create policy "Owners can upload subscription proofs" on storage.objects for insert to authenticated
with check (
  bucket_id = 'subscription-proofs'
  and (storage.foldername(name))[1] = 'workspaces'
  and (storage.foldername(name))[3] = auth.uid()::text
  and public.is_workspace_owner(((storage.foldername(name))[2])::uuid)
);

storage_policy_declarations.name: Owners and finance staff can read subscription proofs
Owners can delete unsubmitted subscription proofs
Business members can upload private documents
storage_policy_declarations.declaration:
create policy "Business members can upload private documents" on storage.objects for insert to authenticated
with check (
  bucket_id = 'business-documents'
  and public.business_storage_workspace_id(name) is not null
  and (storage.foldername(name))[3] = auth.uid()::text
  and public.business_claims_active(public.business_storage_workspace_id(name))
  and public.business_has_permission(public.business_storage_workspace_id(name), 'documents.create')
);

storage_policy_declarations.name: Business members can delete archived or unregistered private documents
storage_policy_declarations.declaration:
create policy "Business members can delete archived or unregistered private documents"
on storage.objects for delete to authenticated using (
  bucket_id = 'business-documents'
  and public.business_storage_workspace_id(name) is not null
  and public.business_claims_active(public.business_storage_workspace_id(name))
  and (
    (public.business_has_permission(public.business_storage_workspace_id(name), 'documents.manage')
      and not exists (select 1 from public.business_documents d
        where d.storage_path = storage.objects.name and d.status = 'active'))
    or ((storage.foldername(name))[3] = auth.uid()::text
      and public.business_has_permission(public.business_storage_workspace_id(name), 'documents.create')
      and not exists (select 1 from public.business_documents d
        where d.storage_path = storage.objects.name))
  )
);

storage_policy_declarations.name: Business members can read registered private documents
storage_policy_declarations.declaration:
create policy "Business members can read registered private documents" on storage.objects for select to authenticated
using(bucket_id='business-documents' and exists(select 1 from public.business_documents d
  where d.storage_path=storage.objects.name and d.status='active'
    and d.workspace_id=public.business_storage_workspace_id(storage.objects.name)
    and public.business_claims_active(d.workspace_id)
    and public.business_has_permission(d.workspace_id,'documents.view')
    and (case when d.parent_type='expense_claim' then public.business_can_view_claim(d.workspace_id,d.parent_id)
      when d.parent_type in ('business_bill','business_bill_payment')
        then public.business_can_view_bill_document(d.workspace_id,d.parent_type,d.parent_id)
      else true end)));

storage_policy_declarations.name: business_subscription_proof_read_guard
storage_policy_declarations.declaration:
create policy business_subscription_proof_read_guard on storage.objects as restrictive for select to authenticated
  using(bucket_id<>'subscription-proofs' or public.business_subscription_proof_access(name));

storage_policy_declarations.name: business_subscription_proof_upload_guard
storage_policy_declarations.declaration:
create policy business_subscription_proof_upload_guard on storage.objects as restrictive for insert to authenticated
  with check(bucket_id<>'subscription-proofs' or public.business_subscription_proof_access(name,true));

storage_policy_declarations.name: business_subscription_proof_delete_guard
storage_policy_declarations.declaration:
create policy business_subscription_proof_delete_guard on storage.objects as restrictive for delete to authenticated
  using(bucket_id<>'subscription-proofs' or public.business_subscription_proof_access(name,true));

storage_policy_declarations.name: business_logos_member_read
storage_policy_declarations.declaration:
create policy business_logos_member_read on storage.objects for select to authenticated
 using(bucket_id='business-logos' and (public.business_logo_readable(name) or public.business_logo_owner(name)));

storage_policy_declarations.name: business_logos_owner_remove
storage_policy_declarations.declaration:
create policy business_logos_owner_remove on storage.objects for delete to authenticated
 using(bucket_id='business-logos' and public.business_logo_owner(name) and not public.business_logo_readable(name));

syntactic_inventory_limit: Literal ordered CREATE/DROP declarations only; not SQL execution, conditional DDL, effective policy semantics/grants, overloaded routine catalog, service settings or deployment.

acceptance_groups.title: Formats/content
cases: Valid allowed formats per surface, including general Business CSV/XLSX
Declared MIME/extension/byte mismatch using harmless fixtures
Empty/truncated/malformed content
Disallowed HTML/SVG/script or harmless polyglot masquerade
Large dimensions/processing or archive-structure boundaries
acceptance_groups.expected: Valid supported content preserved; invalid or unsafe/unverified processing never served as validated.

acceptance_groups.title: Object authorization
cases: Own Personal and intended Family object access
Foreign workspace/uploader/path spoof
Inactive removed member and outsider denied
Suspended/expired state with intended read/delete exceptions
Business scoped role and actual staff/MFA allowlists
acceptance_groups.expected: Direct Storage list/read/sign/upload/delete effects match final permissions; no reliance on hidden UI.

acceptance_groups.title: Registration/binding
cases: Valid object matches record/parent/workspace
Missing/null object metadata and nonexistent object
Object MIME/size/owner/path mismatch
Foreign or disallowed claim/bill/payment parent
Overwrite/delete/archive of active or submitted evidence
acceptance_groups.expected: Authoritative valid binding; impossible/foreign/mismatched registrations denied; approved evidence rules preserved.

acceptance_groups.title: Download/link/session
cases: Allowed view/download renders with safe response/name treatment
Foreign authenticated GET/list/sign attempt denied
Issued URL before/after TTL, removal and role change
Account/workspace switch during pending proof/sign operation
Browser/SW/cache/log/referrer or device residual link exposure
acceptance_groups.expected: Correct bytes and observed access window; stale context never opens another session's result; private tokens omitted from shared receipts.

acceptance_groups.title: Limits/cost/processors
cases: Exact file caps and just-over boundary for proof/logo
Count/aggregate bytes and concurrent reservation boundary
Repeated upload/sign/download rate or egress boundary
Bounded image/ZIP/spreadsheet/PDF processing resource behavior
Known processor/quarantine status and privacy failure/outage
acceptance_groups.expected: Actual supported budgets and failure states enforced; no infinite client retries or unreviewed third-party disclosure.

acceptance_groups.title: Failure/cleanup/preservation
cases: Upload succeeds then registration fails; cleanup result observed
Ambiguous committed registration response; referenced bytes preserved
User/workspace change after upload; orphan manifest retained
Logo replacement/owner transfer/shared evidence cleanup
Idempotent bounded reconciliation and retained audit/financial history
acceptance_groups.expected: Truthful resumable cleanup, no deletion of committed/shared proof, exact unrelated fixture/history preservation.
